description: Yelp business data as JSON from your agent: a local bridge to the hosted HasData Yelp MCP service that searches businesses by keyword and location, fetches one business in full by Yelp ID or alias, and reads its public review feed, returning name, address, published phone and website, price range, categories, rating, hours and reviews as returned upstream. One bin serves a small CLI and a stdio MCP server.
name: @reneturcios/yelpdata
